question: v5
asks: How much will the five largest AI hyperscalers spend in total on data centers in calendar 2026, as shown by their Q4/full-year 2026 earnings and capex disclosures?
settles_on: The big five AI hyperscalers' combined calendar-2026 data center capital expenditure, compared with the nearly $800 billion the article says they will spend this year.

possible_answers.label: from 775,000,000,000 USD to below 825,000,000,000 USD
possible_answers.holds_when: from 775,000,000,000 USD to below 825,000,000,000 USD (the reference when the question opened: "the big five AI hyperscalers will spend nearly $800 billion on data centers this year")
